count_interpretation: Native2185 reported by root installed runtime is drawable stored street precision, not independently reviewed positions. No new live population count performed in this audit.

findings.evidence: diagnosePosition maps street/address/rooftop to street; absent receipt yields legacy_street_unreviewed yet drawable=true. Numeric routes require reviewed receipt separately.
findings.implication: Stored claim may be valid but is not independent accuracy proof.

findings.evidence: Known city/town/village/country/region centroid methods downgrade. Shared cohort excludes multiple city/country or >8 distinct addresses. Precision disagreement,2–8 distinct addresses,source scope and extent reasons alone set review_required without disabling drawable.
findings.implication: Proven conflicting and suspicious points are not uniformly withheld. Shared-building duplicates alone do not prove displacement.

findings.evidence: Both consume complete adaptive explore_geo feed, mapPositionFields then validatePositionCohorts, then hasStreetPosition. Android embed uses same eligibility. Labels describe street-level positions without separating receipt-backed vs legacy claims.
findings.implication: A shared correction applies across web/native, followed by a new native binary when affected packaged modules change.

recommended_order: Measure counts by receipt-backed, legacy claimed, explicit centroid, conflicting metadata and cohort, preserving listing IDs and published eligibility.
Withhold proven contradictory provenance/source-scope points consistently; retain legitimate unreviewed sources with an explicit unverified basis rather than treating all2185 as wrong.
Review bounded suspicious cohorts against exact address/source; do not move points or bulk geocode from cosmetic flags.
Show reviewed and stored/unverified counts separately; numeric directions remain receipt-backed.
